# Classic Red & White Christmas – Traditional Holiday Seamless Pattern
Celebrate the timeless spirit of the holiday season with **Classic Red & White Christmas**. This festive digital pattern collection features a cheerful **red and white Christmas palette** combined with classic holiday motifs such as **Christmas trees, ornaments, candy canes, holly leaves, evergreen branches, berries, snowflakes, stars, ribbons, bows, and charming seasonal accents**.
Inspired by traditional Christmas decorations, nostalgic holiday wrapping paper, cozy winter celebrations, and classic festive styling, this collection brings a bright and joyful touch to creative projects. Its versatile aesthetic is perfect for **scrapbooking, junk journals, greeting cards, gift wrapping, stationery, fabric, apparel, home décor, packaging, and holiday crafts**.
